description: This file defines a servlet filter 'ContentUrlFilter' that intercepts HTTP requests to process specific content URL patterns, query data from the database about content, and forward requests accordingly within an Apache OFBiz application.

classes.name: ContentUrlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter implementing logic to intercept requests for content URL handling, querying content-related entities, and forwarding to appropriate views.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main method that processes each HTTP request, determines if a special content URL pattern is present, retrieves content info from the database, and forwards the request accordingly.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is destroyed. Currently, it is empty.
